protocol.name: worker-protocol
notes: This is a byte-level contract assembled from the original worker glue, the recovered input entry point and the recovered snapshot decoder.
Fields whose exact wire type has not been proven are marked confidence medium and described by role, not invented names.

fields.name: callbackId
fields.note: -1 for init; otherwise a monotonically increasing client callback slot

fields.name: data
fields.note: transferred Uint8Array; absent or zero-length for init/think/flush

fields.name: finalResponse
fields.note: true completes the callback; false is an intermediate packet

functions.name: sp_server_init
functions.behavior: initialize world and catalogs, schedule the 50 ms tick, flush initial output

functions.name: sp_server_send
functions.behavior: decode one client input packet and apply its commands

functions.name: sp_server_flush
functions.behavior: drain the output queue, send one final empty response, free packets

fieldNotes: Opcode 12 angle uses the original binary64 constants and is normalized as the original bit test does.
Name strings are trimmed and UTF-8 truncated on the original spawn path.

domainSparse.note: Domain semantics also include petal slot/instance fields11/12; see docs/semantics/snapshot.md. Shared value widths do not assert native semantic equivalence.

domainExtensions.name: entity-kind
domainExtensions.note: Domain packets retain the permanent kind byte; the archived-client adapter writes the original model byte separately.

fieldTypes.note: Shared field value categories and dense widths. Consult sparseModes for indexed/scalar framing; domainSparse is not the native wire contract.
